records.title: A Decade of Evidence of Trend Following Investing in Cryptocurrencies
records.claim: Walk-forward cryptocurrency trend following showed persistent opportunity and provides an explicit trend-family prior.
records.notes: Code is linked by the paper; use as a direct family prior, not as proof of ZEL profitability.

records.title: Catching Crypto Trends; A Tactical Approach for Bitcoin and Altcoins
records.claim: An ensemble of Donchian trend models plus volatility-based sizing produced net-of-fee risk-adjusted outperformance in a survivorship-bias-free crypto universe.

records.title: Momentum in the Cryptocurrency Market: A Comprehensive Analysis under Realistic Assumptions
records.claim: Time-series momentum evidence is stronger than cross-sectional momentum once liquidation risk and realistic assumptions are considered.

records.title: Trend-following Strategies for Crypto Investors
records.claim: Trend-following performed well in the studied crypto sample, while transaction costs had a substantial impact on portfolio performance.

records.title: Machine Learning-Based Bitcoin Trading Under Transaction Costs: Evidence From Walk-Forward Forecasting
records.claim: Naive hourly signals failed after 10bp costs; a cost-aware execution threshold reduced turnover and restored profitability in selected configurations.

records.title: Bollinger Bands under Varying Market Regimes: A Comparative Study of Breakout and Mean-Reversion Strategies in BTC/USDT
records.claim: Breakout and mean-reversion performance in BTC/USDT was strongly regime-dependent; breakout aligned better with sustained volatility expansion while mean reversion degraded in persistent declines.

records.title: Volume Profile Mean Reversion Strategy with Tape Speed Confirmation for Cryptocurrency Futures Markets
records.claim: Five-minute SOL/USDT mean reversion using prior-day volume-profile levels and momentum confirmation highlights that stop distance must clear realistic fee and slippage burden.

records.title: Evaluating the Performance of a Donchian Channel Breakout Strategy with ATR-Based Risk Management
records.claim: BTC Donchian breakout combined with ATR volatility filtering and ATR risk management; results were sensitive to transaction costs, parameters and market conditions.

records.title: Cross-sectional Momentum in Cryptocurrency Markets
records.claim: Short-term crypto momentum was observed using roughly 30-day ranking and 7-day continuation; use as a portfolio-family prior, not as an intraday rule.

records.title: Revisiting Trend-following and Mean-Reversion Strategies in Bitcoin
records.claim: Extended Bitcoin tests through 2024 found the local-maximum trend rule remained materially more robust OOS than the local-minimum mean-reversion rule.

records.title: Systematic Trend-Following with Adaptive Portfolio Construction: Enhancing Risk-Adjusted Alpha in Cryptocurrency Markets
records.claim: A 6-hour crypto trend framework combines volatility-aware trailing, adaptive asset selection and asymmetric long/short allocation with OOS and cost sensitivity tests.

records.title: Market Regime Analysis Across Asset Classes: A UMAP Clustering Study of Cryptocurrency, Forex, and Equity Markets
records.claim: Bitcoin displayed distinct regime-switching and stronger trend asymmetry than the traditional assets in the study.

records.title: Global and Local Drivers of Bitcoin Trading Vis-A-Vis Fiat Currencies
records.claim: Crypto-market momentum and financial-market volatility are relevant drivers of Bitcoin trading activity across fiat pairs.

records.title: Demystifying Time-Series Momentum Strategies: Volatility Estimators, Trading Rules and Pairwise Correlations
records.claim: Time-series momentum robustness depends on volatility estimation, trading rule construction, correlation handling and transaction-cost control.

records.title: Does Trend-Following Still Work on Stocks?
records.claim: High-turnover trend following can lose viability after costs; explicit turnover control can materially improve net performance.

records.title: Revisiting Trend-following and Mean-reversion Strategies in Bitcoin
records.claim: Quantpedia's OOS extension found the MAX/trend rule remained effective while the MIN/mean-reversion rule weakened, reinforcing regime/family separation.

records.title: Catching Crypto Trends; A Tactical Approach for Bitcoin and Altcoins
records.claim: Public implementation description confirms a multi-lookback Donchian ensemble, liquidity selection, volatility sizing and cost mitigation rather than a single fixed breakout threshold.

records.title: Trading Strategy AI getting-started examples
records.claim: The public examples include a BTC 15m ATR breakout gated by daily ADX and multipair ATR breakout variants, supporting multi-timeframe regime gating as an implementation prior.

records.title: BTC Breakout trend follower with a volatility-adjusted trailing stop
records.claim: A public BTC implementation uses breakout entry alternatives and ATR-based initial/activation/trailing stops; the author stresses multiple uncorrelated systems and multiple timeframes.

records.title: trend-following-backtesting-strategies
records.claim: A public multi-variant sweep reports 55-bar Donchian, ATR risk, staged targets/trailing and momentum gating among top variants while faster breakouts and Keltner complexity failed in its test universe.

records.title: Volatility Squeeze Momentum strategy
records.claim: A public crypto squeeze-breakout implementation combines compression, ATR-margin breakout, momentum and volume spike confirmation on 1H-8H timeframes and reports low-turnover backtest results.

records.title: r/algotrading: To people currently running a live strategy - what's your next move?
records.claim: Multiple practitioners emphasize strategy diversification, simple rule-based hypotheses, sensitivity testing and rejecting most candidates; one reports live breakout use with significant losing-trade frequency.

records.title: I quit my job to do full-time crypto-trading. Made 12 BTC profit last month
records.claim: A high-read anecdotal thread repeatedly describes breakout confirmation, retest entry and stop placement around the broken level; performance claims are not independently verified.

records.title: Top bitcoin trading strategies
records.claim: The community discussion repeatedly names trend and breakout trading as common Bitcoin approaches but provides no rigorous economic validation.

records.title: QuantConnect Strategy Discussion 179
records.claim: A complex crypto mean-reversion/ML stack was later reported with strongly negative corrected CAGR after a data issue was patched, making it a useful warning against complexity and corrupted-data validation.
